allowedSourceMaterial.overview: When Scott and Kate Johansen’s daughter gets into the college of her dreams it’s cause for celebration. That is, until Scott and Kate learn that the scholarship they were counting on didn’t come through, and they’re now on the hook for tuition they can’t begin to afford. With the help of their friend and neighbor Frank also in need of a major payday they decide to open an illegal casino in his suburban house, risking everything together on a Vegas-style bacchanal where money flows, inhibitions are checked at the door, and all bets are off.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can an illicit suburban gambling haven stay hidden once the cash starts flowing and the neighborhood loses all control?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Faced with their daughter's lost college scholarship, Scott and Kate Johansen team up with neighbor Frank to launch an underground, Vegas-style casino in a quiet suburban home.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and easygoing, delivering broad comedy energy and escalating neighborhood chaos in a compact 88 minutes.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Andrew J. Cohen, this brisk comedy spins domestic desperation into chaotic excess as regular suburbanites take staggering financial and criminal risks.
